snippet.title: Castlevania Remnants of Darkness: Demo Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Castlevania Remnants of Darkness is a 2D metroidvania based on the gameplay of Symphony of the Night (and DSvanias), fused with mechanics from the 3D Castlevania games, such as summoning Innocent Devils and collecting relics and orbs that amplify your magical powers.

You can find the download to the demo here:
https://github.com/GianImpr/Castlevania-Remnants-of-Darkness

Consider joining the discord if you have any questions or need help, of if you just want to hang out with the community:
https://discord.gg/MZBGxt6ySp

A huge thank you to everyone who has helped me achieve this so far!
I look forward to continue working on this game with all of my passion.

For more information on the fangame, please check the GitHub page.

Garibaldi Courtyard remix by BELMONT LEGACY: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bj5nJQLQ0zI
